summary: Phase 4 used its review attempt budget. The latest counter-review found one accepted material issue: the real-host evidence for the two-tool catalogue is digest-bound to the pre-merge bundle, not the shipped dist, so the final bytes lack host evidence bound to them. The fix is mechanical and worthwhile — re-run the opt-in real-host suite (ARCHFLOW_REAL_HOSTS=1) against the tracked dist and re-record the artifact, transcript, and notes. A second minor finding about supersession wording in the historical validation runbook was rejected as documentation polish. Decide whether to spend another review attempt on that fix or stop here.
